## Research status

**Technical owners.** 5 canonical routes.

**Owner routes.** [Compact Generative Systems: Generate, Verify, Repair, and Residual Honesty](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/compact-generative-systems-and-residual-honesty.html), [Fast Generation Architectures](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/fast-generation-architectures.html), [Governed Deliberation and Test-Time Scaling](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/governed-deliberation-and-test-time-scaling.html), [RankFold, NeuralFold, and Artifact Compression](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/rankfold-neuralfold-and-artifact-compression.html), [Resource Economics and Token Budgets](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/resource-economics-and-token-budgets.html).

**Core support states.** argument.

**Implemented bounded proof targets.** 38.

**Current boundary.** Editorial synthesis does not transfer support among owners and does not establish system-level efficiency, safety, deployment readiness, AGI, or ASI.

**What would change the conclusion.** Matched effect-complete studies showing static budgets or one general model equal or outperform governed allocation would narrow the resource layer.

**Technical evidence.** Follow the owner routes above and the live book's claim/evidence registry.
:::
